about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Nativity of the Lord — Mass during the Day” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant, we beseech Thee, almighty God, that the Savior of the world, born this day, as He is for us the author of divine generation, may likewise Himself be the giver of immortality. Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
